decisions.title: How is a section stored — a new top-level sections[] array at schema_version 3, or a UI-only projection over the existing blocks[]?
options: New sections[] array at schema_version 3; the agent compiles sections directly to AST and blocks[] stays only for v1/v2
Sections stay a UI projection; the wizard still writes blocks[] so the compiler is untouched
decisions.recommended: New sections[] array at schema_version 3; the agent compiles sections directly to AST and blocks[] stays only for v1/v2
decisions.answer: New sections[] array at schema_version 3; the agent compiles sections directly to AST and blocks[] stays only for v1/v2

decisions.title: The four approver labels (Author / Quality Control / Reviewed By / Customer) do not map semantically onto the stored ids (author / reviewer / approver / recipient). How do we bridge that?
options: Map positionally and keep the four stored ids untouched — labels come from the message catalogue
Rename the stored role ids to match the labels, changing APPROVER_ROLES, the fixtures and the mirror region
decisions.recommended: Map positionally and keep the four stored ids untouched — labels come from the message catalogue
decisions.answer: Map positionally and keep the four stored ids untouched — labels come from the message catalogue

decisions.title: Are the four new Azure collectors (VNet, public IP, NSG rules, Advisor) part of this spec's task list or a follow-up spec?
options: In this spec as a later phase, after the UI restructure lands
Deferred to a follow-up spec; this spec ships the UI restructure and marks those four sections unavailable
decisions.recommended: In this spec as a later phase, after the UI restructure lands
decisions.answer: In this spec as a later phase, after the UI restructure lands

decisions.title: Subnets and NSG rules are one-to-many per resource. How does the snapshot model them?
options: Synthetic child resources carrying real ARM ids, projected with mv-expand — resource_table and the fact model work unchanged
List-valued facts plus a new subrecord_table block type
decisions.recommended: Synthetic child resources carrying real ARM ids, projected with mv-expand — resource_table and the fact model work unchanged
decisions.answer: Synthetic child resources carrying real ARM ids, projected with mv-expand — resource_table and the fact model work unchanged

decisions.title: How is the section catalogue kept identical across both halves?

Sentinel-delimited declarations in each half, compared by mirror.static.test.ts
decisions.recommended: One shared JSON file read by both halves, the way catalog/metrics.v1.json already is
decisions.answer: One shared JSON file read by both halves, the way catalog/metrics.v1.json already is

No — keep the collectors-last ordering from the original description and build the wizard against a stubbed scan
